boundary.description: From the confluence of the Rivers Irwell and Irk, by the River Irwell to a point opposite Fennell Street, then by Fennell Street, Withy Grove, Shudehill, Miller Street, Cheetham Hill Road to and along the River Irwell to and by the Manchester-Bury Metrolink line to Smedley Lane, then along Smedley Lane, Cheetham Hill Road, Waterloo Road, Bury New Road and Sherborne Street West and a bee-line to the River Irwell and by the River Irwell to its confluence with the River Irk.
